# Clarity Chat

> Enterprise-grade React component library for building beautiful, accessible AI chat interfaces. Features 200+ production-ready components, 140+ custom hooks, 11+ themes, and comprehensive token optimization. Built with TypeScript, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.

Clarity Chat is the most complete open-source solution for building AI chat interfaces in React. It provides everything you need from basic chat windows to enterprise features like SSO, multi-tenancy, and advanced analytics.

## Entry Points

Three bundle options for different needs:

- `@clarity-chat/react` (~120KB gzipped): Full library with all 200+ components
- `@clarity-chat/react/core` (~60KB gzipped): Core chat components without dashboards/analytics
- `@clarity-chat/react/core-minimal` (~30KB gzipped): Minimal bundle with lazy loading for features
- `@clarity-chat/react/test-utils`: Testing utilities (not for production builds)

## Quick Start

- [Installation](https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/installation): Install via npm: `npm install @clarity-chat/react`
- [Quick Start Guide](https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/quick-start): Build your first chat interface in 5 minutes
- [Interactive Playground](https://clarity-chat.dev/playground): Try components live in the browser

## Core Concepts

- [Component System](https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/concepts/components): Understanding Clarity's composable component architecture
- [React Hooks](https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/concepts/hooks): 35+ hooks for chat functionality, streaming, and state management
- [Theming System](https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/concepts/theming): 11+ pre-built themes with full customization support
- [Animations](https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/concepts/animations): 150+ micro-interactions with Framer Motion
- [Architecture](https://clarity-chat.dev/learn/architecture): Three-tier API design philosophy

## Main Components

- [ClarityChat](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/clarity-chat): All-in-one chat component with built-in features
- [ChatWindow](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/chat-window): Container component for chat interfaces
- [MessageList](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/message-list): Display messages with virtualization support
- [ChatInput](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/chat-input): User input with attachments and voice support
- [StreamingMessage](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/streaming-message): Real-time streaming response display
- [ThinkingIndicator](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/thinking-indicator): AI processing state indicator
- [TokenCounter](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/token-counter): Track token usage in real-time

## Core Hooks

- [useClarityChat](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/hooks/use-clarity-chat): Primary hook for chat state and operations with memory integration
- [useStreamingSSE](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/hooks/use-streaming-sse): Server-Sent Events streaming
- [useStreamingWebSocket](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/hooks/use-streaming-websocket): WebSocket streaming with auto-reconnection
- [useTokenTracker](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/hooks/use-token-tracker): Monitor token consumption
- [useTokenOptimization](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/hooks/use-token-optimization): Optimize context window usage
- [useVoiceInput](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/hooks/use-voice-input): Voice-to-text input
- [useChatHandlers](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/hooks/use-chat-handlers): Pre-configured handlers for ChatWindow

## UI Components

- [Button](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/button): Accessible button with variants
- [Avatar](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/avatar): User and AI avatars
- [Badge](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/badge): Status and info badges
- [Toast](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/toast): Notification system
- [Tooltip](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/tooltip): Contextual tooltips
- [Skeleton](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/skeleton): Loading state placeholders
- [Progress](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/progress): Progress indicators

## Advanced Features

- [VoiceInput](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/voice-input): Speech-to-text integration
- [FileUpload](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/file-upload): Document and image uploads

- [ConversationTimeline](https://clarity-chat.dev/reference/components/conversation-timeline): Visual conversation history

## AI-Optimized APIs

Programmatic access to Clarity Chat documentation for AI systems and RAG applications:

- [Components API](https://clarity-chat.dev/api/ai/components): JSON endpoint with all component documentation
- [Hooks API](https://clarity-chat.dev/api/ai/hooks): JSON endpoint with all hook documentation
- [Search API](https://clarity-chat.dev/api/ai/search): Full-text search across all documentation
- [Health API](https://clarity-chat.dev/api/ai/health): API health and status monitoring
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://clarity-chat.dev/openapi.json): Full OpenAPI 3.0 specification

### MCP Server

Model Context Protocol server for Claude Code and other AI tools:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "clarity-chat": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["tsx", "apps/docs/mcp-server/index.ts"]
    }
  }
}
```

Available MCP tools: `list_components`, `get_component`, `list_hooks`, `get_hook`, `search_docs`, `health_check`
